verdict.rationale: The evidence documents individual payouts: fiat payouts to first- or third-party bank accounts, sending stablecoins, and payout webhooks. Nothing shows a batch or bulk payout API that submits many payouts in one operation with per-item status. Single-payout capability does not count as mass disbursement.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can run mass disbursements — batch or bulk payout APIs that push many stablecoin or fiat payouts in one documented operation with per-item status
